name: Complementary Coefficient Spaces Need Not Be Homeomorphic
definition: For $n\ge1$, compare $C=\{0,1\}^n\setminus\{1^n\}$ with its singleton complement.
properties: The punctured cube has one full-support missing pattern and coefficient space the open simplex $\Delta_{n-1}^\circ$. A singleton has only singleton-supported missing patterns and coefficient space a point. For $n\ge2$ these complementary coefficient spaces are homotopy equivalent but not homeomorphic, motivating Euclidean stabilization in complement duality.
